name: Poly Molly (2,245 free low-poly 3D models, editable in the browser)
summary: Library of 2,245 low-poly game models in 44 themed packs plus 326 rigged characters, all generated from code recipes (no AI image/3D generators per the publisher). Each model can be resized and recolored in the browser Studio, then downloaded at real-metre scale as GLB or USDZ (FBX, OBJ, Godot and Unity packages with a free account). Free for commercial use, no credit required.

access.price: $0 low-poly catalog; Pro HD/Weathering $9.99/mo or $99/yr, Lifetime $149 (not on sale yet)
access.notes: No credit needed. No resale/redistribution of the files, no AI training or building a competing generator, no bulk scraping. GLB/USDZ without account; FBX/OBJ/engine packages need a free email account. Custom builds rate-limited (50/hour).

procedure: Open polymolly.dev/library and search or pick a pack.
Open a model page; optionally change size or colours in Studio.
Click 'Download GLB · Free' (no account) or sign in with a free account for FBX, OBJ, Godot or Unity packages.

verdict.why: Large, coherent free low-poly library launched 2026-11-25 with clear commercial-use license and no-account GLB download (verified); parametric recolor/resize is a real differentiator. Restrictions (no redistribution/AI training) and freemium HD upsell noted.
